title: Liposonix vs 5D Lipozero: How They Differ
h1: Liposonix vs 5D Lipozero: how they differ
desc: Liposonix vs 5D Lipozero compared: how each works, treatment areas, sessions, downtime, limitations and who needs assessment, at Skin & Laser Dubai Marina.
answer: Liposonix uses high-intensity focused ultrasound to destroy a larger volume of fat in one session, mainly on the abdomen and flanks. 5D Lipozero combines radiofrequency, cavitation and vacuum to reduce fat and tighten skin area by area, from the chin to the legs, usually over 1 to 2 sessions per area. Neither is a weight-loss treatment.
facts: Liposonix: fat volume; Lipozero: fat and skin
Liposonix: abdomen, flanks; Lipozero: chin to legs
Liposonix: usually 1; Lipozero: 1 to 2 per area
body:
## Which concern each addresses

- A defined belly or flank bulge: Liposonix is designed for this
- Smaller areas, loose skin or the chin: 5D Lipozero also tightens
- Both: [stubborn fat](/stubborn-fat-treatment-dubai/) in people near their goal weight

## Important limitations

Neither replaces weight loss. Liposonix can cause tenderness for a few days; Lipozero results build over several weeks. People with hernias, implants in the area or who are pregnant need assessment first.
faq: Can I combine Liposonix and Lipozero?
Yes, in a staged plan your doctor designs.
Liposonix often needs one session; Lipozero builds over a short course.
